title: Be an accredited rail transport operator
what: Be accredited by the National Rail Safety Regulator before carrying out railway operations.

laws.title: Rail Safety National Law (Tasmania), as set out in the Schedule to the Rail Safety National Law (South Australia) Act 2012

sources.title: Rail Safety National Law (Tasmania), as set out in the Schedule to the Rail Safety National Law (South Australia) Act 2012
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 62(1) of the National Law (version of 2023-05-01)
sources.quote: A person must not carry out any railway operations unless the person— (a) is a rail transport operator who— (i) is accredited under this Part in respect of those operations;
